review_candidates.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world. Role Overview The Insider Threat Counter Operations (ITCO) is the Coupang Red team for insider risk security, proactively probing our controls and processes and generating actionable insights to drive high impact enterprise improvements for insider risk resilience. We are seeking a deeply technical ITCO Engineer to lead offensive simulation campaigns from our Seattle office. In this role, you will perfect a malicious insider mindset and leverage your technical knowledge and experience to design and execute realistic simulations, to evaluate effectiveness and efficiency of our insider risk management posture, to include the performance of IT Security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), Global Investigation, HR, and Legal controls and processes. You will bridge innovative tactical operations with enterprise security program management to ensure Coupang stays ahead of the evolving insider risk landscape. What You Will Do Ideate, design, and execute realistic, high impact insider threat simulation campaigns with trending, risk-based attack vectors for sensitive data exfiltration, privilege abuse, and system sabotage. Design and execute integrity testing of technical controls for IT Security, Information Security, DLP, IAM, and legal hold. Develop and enhance custom tooling, existing techniques, and automated frameworks to scale simulation capabilities and optimize ITCO testing infrastructure. Produce high impact reports that translate tactical findings into actionable insights to drive enterprise security program strategy and process improvements. Basic Qualifications Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or a related field 6 years of experience in Security Engineering or Cybersecurity Preferred Qualifications 7+ years in offensive operations, digital forensics, red teaming, penetration testing, or insider threat engineering. Knowledge and experience with investigation of insider threat incidents and in-depth understanding of insider threat mindset and behavior patterns. Knowledge and experience working within Data Privacy, Identity Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and core information security control frameworks. Capable of emulating an “insider threat” mindset and passionate about building a high impact simulation program. Hands-on development/scripting skills to create automation, expand and enhance existing tools and techniques, and evaluate and onboard new tools. Experience operating within large-scale e-commerce or high-growth tech environments. Familiarity with South Korean data security regulations, compliance standards, and legal frameworks. Fluent in English and native Korean proficiency. Pay & Benefits Our compensation reflects the cost of living across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $142,000/year to $309,000/year. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills and experience. review_candidates.description: Vi söker en IT-specialist-infrastruktur inriktning digitalt samarbete som vill vara med och bidra till en problemfri vardag för våra medarbetare. Hos oss får du möjlighet att verkligen göra skillnad i en verksamhet med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Om tjänsten I rollen som IT-specialist infrastruktur inriktning digitalt samarbete hos oss arbetar du med drift- och förvaltning samt utveckling av informationssystem och tjänster kopplat till digitala samarbetsplattformar (t ex Skype, Exchange). Du driftar och utvecklar även UEM samt arbetar med change och incident hantering inom sammarbetsplattformar. Samarbete med plattformsdrift och andra tekniska team ingår också såväl som hantering och arbete i ServiceNow och DevOps. Som IT-specialist infrastrukur arbetar du även med omvärldsbevakning för såväl hård- och mjukvara inom ansvarsområdena. Du skapar nödvändiga underlag för upphandling/beställning och deltar i framtagandet av underhåll-och förvaltningsplan. Rollen rapporterar till, och stödjer, tjänsteägare och tjänsteområdesansvarig. Om dig Vi söker dig som har eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område eller motsvarande erfarenhet förvärvad på annat sätt som bedöms som likvärdig. Du har flera års relevant erfarenhet som IT infrastrukturtekniker samt erfarenhet av Windows klient och server operativsystem. Därtill har du även erfarenhet av felsökning i IT-miljöer. Du har även grundläggande kompetens att hantera drift av server, operativsystem, nätverk och Active Directory. Det ses som en fördel om du även har erfarenhet av exchange och UEM verktyg samt Skype och Teams (eller liknande). Även erfarenhet av upphandling och kravställan till exempel HW Mobiltelefoni och PC:s ses som meriterande. Därtill är även erfarenhet av arbete enl ITIL, hantering av säkerhetsklassade informationssystem och arbete med godkännande ur säkerhetssynpunkt meriterande. Ytterligare meriterande erfarenhet är arbete med ServiceNow som ärendehanteringsverktyg. Så även kunskap om informationssäkerhetsarbete. Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet. Du kommer att arbeta på infrastrukturstaben som ansvarar för IT-verksamhet, informationsförvaltning och fastighetsförvaltning som möjliggör ett effektivt och säkert arbete. review_candidates.description: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. Role Summary The Microsoft 365 Domain Specialist role is accountable for the day-to-day operation, governance, and continuous improvement of core Microsoft 365 services, with a strong focus on SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and associated collaboration platforms. Working closely with Architecture, Service Management, Security, and external partners, the role ensures M365 services are stable, secure, and aligned to enterprise standards. The focus is on platform operations, adoption support, and governance rather than deep solution design or development. The role ensures SharePoint and M365 services continue to deliver a consistent, high-quality user experience while supporting safe and effective adoption of Copilot and light-touch automation capabilities through the Power Platform. Key Responsibilities M365 Platform Operations and Governance Support the in-life management of Microsoft 365 services including SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration tools. Ensure services operate within agreed security, compliance, and governance frameworks. Work with architecture and security teams to maintain alignment with enterprise standards and policies. Support service reviews, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. SharePoint and Collaboration Services Act as the primary domain specialist for SharePoint Online, supporting site lifecycle, structure, permissions, and governance. Ensure best practices for content management, document collaboration, and site design are followed. Support business users in onboarding, adoption, and effective use of SharePoint capabilities. Assist with managing integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive. Copilot Enablement and Adoption Support the rollout and day-to-day operation of Microsoft 365 Copilot across key workloads. Ensure readiness of SharePoint and M365 data sources for Copilot consumption, aligned with security and compliance controls. Work with stakeholders to promote safe and effective use of Copilot features to improve productivity. Monitor usage trends and support feedback loops for continuous improvement. Power Platform Support Provide basic support for Power Platform components (Power Automate, Power Apps) used within M365 workflows. Assist with governance and oversight of low-code solutions to ensure alignment with organisational policies. Support citizen developers with guidance on best practices and platform usage. Operational Support and Service Management Ensure operational readiness including documentation, runbooks, and support processes are maintained. Work with service teams and vendors to resolve incidents and manage escalations. Support service performance monitoring, including availability, usage, and user experience. Contribute to service improvement plans and operational reporting. Stakeholder Engagement Work with business users, product owners, and technical teams to understand requirements and improve service outcomes. Act as a bridge between business needs and platform capabilities. Support communication and training initiatives to drive adoption of M365 services. Evergreen Platform Management Work closely with Operations and Engineering teams to review and assess new Microsoft Message Center notifications Translate upcoming changes into actionable plans, ensuring timely validation, testing, and communication Coordinate implementation activities to minimise user or service impact Ensure changes are deployed in alignment with governance, security, and release management standards Maintain the Microsoft 365 platform in an evergreen state by proactively managing updates, features, and service changes Essential About you Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services, particularly SharePoint Online and collaboration tools. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities and adoption considerations. Basic understanding of Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) in a business context. Experience working in an operational or service management role within an enterprise environment. Understanding of governance, security, and compliance considerations within M365 (e.g., access control, data handling). Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. Ability to work with external vendors and managed service providers. Preferred Exposure to SharePoint governance models, site lifecycle management, and content organisation. Familiarity with Copilot readiness concepts such as data access, permissions, and compliance alignment. Basic knowledge of Power Platform governance or Centre of Excellence practices. Awareness of ITIL or service management frameworks. Experience supporting adoption or change initiatives within digital workplace platforms. Job Posting End Date 2026-09-10 Equal Opportunities Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong. During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions. Adjustment or Accommodations Request If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. Note to candidates The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
